# cfKanban

> An open-source, self-hosted Kanban for people who work through Agents.

cfKanban lets Agents and people collaborate on Issues, comments, priorities, assignments, and completion records. One Cloudflare Worker serves the API, bilingual Web board, and documentation; D1 stores the core data, with optional private R2 storage for attachments.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/breakstring/cfKanban): source code and releases.

## Install the Skills

Use the official installation guide to set up the latest stable release for your Agent host. Reuse a trusted, compatible installation when one is already available.

- [Installation guide (English)](https://github.com/breakstring/cfKanban/releases/latest/download/install.md)
- [安装指南（简体中文）](https://github.com/breakstring/cfKanban/releases/latest/download/install.zh-CN.md)

Example request:

```text
Read https://github.com/breakstring/cfKanban/releases/latest/download/install.md and install the latest stable cfKanban Skills for me.
```

The bundle provides four Skills:

- `cfkanban-howto`: explain capabilities and choose the right workflow.
- `cfkanban`: join Projects and work with Issues, comments, and boards.
- `cfkanban-admin`: manage Workspaces, Projects, members, invitations, and Owner settings within your scope.
- `cfkanban-deploy`: install, deploy, update, or recover cfKanban.

Installation alone does not grant Project access or create a cloud instance. Local Skill updates and online instance upgrades are separate actions.

## Deploy your own instance

Prepare a Cloudflare account and an Owner display name. The deployment workflow checks the environment, reuses or installs Skills as needed, and presents the exact plan before executing authorized changes.

- [Agent deployment guide (English)](/deploy-guide.md)
- [Agent 部署指南（简体中文）](/deploy-guide.zh-CN.md)

```text
Use cfkanban-deploy to deploy my own cfKanban instance with the latest stable release. First check readiness and show me the deployment plan.
```

## Join and use a Project

Give the Agent the administrator's complete invitation message or the Public Join prompt from the instance homepage. Use the verified instance and Project; joining can include Skill setup when needed.

- [Agent joining guide (English)](/join.md)
- [Agent 加入指南（简体中文）](/join.zh-CN.md)

After joining, describe your task directly. These are independent examples; replace `DemoProject` and `CFK-123` with your targets:

```text
Show my unfinished Issues in DemoProject, ordered by priority.
Create a backlog Issue in DemoProject titled "Review the onboarding guide".
Move CFK-123 to Todo.
Add a comment to CFK-123: "The draft is ready for review."
Complete CFK-123 and record the actual result, verification, and remaining follow-ups.
```

Agents, Web, and supported CLI commands use the same Service permissions and business rules. Completion records should contain actual work and verification evidence.
